scripts.typecheck: tsc -b packages/wheel --pretty false && tsc -p packages/demos --noEmit --pretty false && tsc -p packages/docs --noEmit --pretty false && tsc -p packages/playground --noEmit --pretty false && tsc -p packages/tracker --noEmit --pretty false && tsc -p packages/website --noEmit --pretty false && tsc -p cloudflare --noEmit --pretty false
scripts.test: bun run test:unit:components && bun run test:unit:node
scripts.test:elixir: sh -c 'cd elixir/wheel_sync && mix deps.get && mix format --check-formatted && mix test --warnings-as-errors && cd ../tracker && mix deps.get && mix format --check-formatted && mix compile --warnings-as-errors'
scripts.check:static: bun run lint && bun run schema:wire:check && bun run schema:tracker:check && bun run seed:tracker:check && bun run docs:robots:check && bun run typecheck && bun run check:tracker-services && bun run check:wrangler-types && bun run test:package
scripts.check:unit: bun run test && bun run test:docs && bun run test:backends && bun run test:wire && bun run test:elixir
scripts.check:browser: bun run docs:build && bun run test:browser && bun run test:browser:components && bun run test:browser:demos && bun run test:behaviors:smoke && bun run test:browser:website
scripts.check: bun run check:static && bun run check:unit && bun run check:browser && bun run check:cloudflare
scripts.test:browser:tracker:sqlite: bun run --cwd packages/tracker build && TRACKER_BROWSER_BACKEND=sqlite playwright test --config packages/tracker/playwright.config.ts
scripts.test:browser:tracker:postgres: bun run --cwd packages/tracker build && TRACKER_BROWSER_BACKEND=postgres playwright test --config packages/tracker/playwright.config.ts
scripts.test:browser:tracker:all: bun run test:browser:tracker:sqlite && bun run test:browser:tracker:postgres
scripts.test:browser:components: bun run --cwd packages/playground audit:build && playwright test --config packages/playground/playwright.config.ts
scripts.dev:demos:preview: bun run --cwd packages/demos build && portless wheel-demos-preview bun run --cwd packages/demos preview
scripts.demos:embed: DEMOS_BASE=/demos/ VITE_SYNC_MODE=browser vite build --config packages/demos/vite.config.ts --outDir dist-embed
scripts.website: bun run demos:embed && bunx vite --config packages/website/vite.config.ts
scripts.website:build: bun run demos:embed && bunx vite build --config packages/website/vite.config.ts
scripts.dev:tracker:preview: bun run --cwd packages/tracker build && portless wheel-tracker-preview bun run --cwd packages/tracker preview
scripts.test:browser:demos: bun run --cwd packages/demos build && playwright test --config packages/demos/playwright.config.ts --grep-invert '@(standalone|embedded)'
scripts.test:behaviors:smoke: bun run --cwd packages/demos build && playwright test --config packages/demos/playwright.config.ts --grep '@smoke'
scripts.check:behaviors: bun run --cwd packages/demos build && playwright test --config packages/demos/playwright.config.ts --grep '@(standalone|embedded)'
